title: Bar Juice 5000 Double Apple Shisha 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Double Apple Shisha from Bar Juice 5000 delivers a classic blend inspired by well-loved shisha-style flavours. Sweet Red Apple forms the base with its rounded, fruity warmth, while crisp Green Apple adds a brighter, tangier edge. A hint of gentle spice gives the mix extra depth, finishing with a clean layer of Ice for a refreshing exhale. Formulated with nicotine salts, this e-liquid provides quick nicotine absorption and a comfortable throat feel, ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) kits such as refillable vape kits and vape starter kits . Available in 5mg, 10mg and 20mg strengths, it caters to different vaping preferences. Made in the UK and blended at 50PG/50VG, Bar Juice 5000 Nic Salts showcase concentrated flavour with discreet vapour production, perfect for fruit-led profiles with a chilled finish.
